title: Workplace Cafe Management Program Alongside Other Larkspur Table Programmes
content:
Holding an office pantry programme at the same site as a cafe management contract under the Workplace Cafe Management Program changes what the cafe contract charges and what it will accept, as does holding a micro market at the same site.

**Pantry co-location and the administration fee — no longer in force.** The basis formerly stated that where the same client held an active pantry programme at the site named on the cafe contract, the cafe administration fee was not charged on invoiced food cost for that site, because the pantry programme already carried a delivery and handling charge for the same kitchen. That clause is no longer in force, superseded by the current basis.

**Micro market co-location and the daily ceiling — in force.** Where the same client holds an active micro market at the site named on the cafe contract, subsidy funding paid into the cafe contract may be drawn at the market kiosk as well as at the cafe counter, and the daily ceiling printed against the cafe service model then covers both outlets together rather than each separately. This clause remains in force.

**Executive Dining Service exclusivity — in force.** A cafe contract and an Executive Dining Service contract at the same site are mutually exclusive: a site already holding an Executive Dining Service contract does not take a second cafe contract of any service model, and the additional floor is served as a further station on the executive contract instead. This clause remains in force.

**How these exemptions are written across the service models.** Both the pantry co-location treatment and the micro market shared daily ceiling are written against every service model of the Workplace Cafe Management Program except Executive Dining Service; consistent with the exclusivity above, no co-location exemption with a pantry or micro market programme is written for that service model, since a site already holding it does not hold a second, separate cafe contract to which such an exemption could attach.

**Where the other programme closes.** Where the pantry or market programme at the site closes, the exemptions it carried stop with the next invoice raised and are not clawed back on invoices already issued. This clause remains in force.

superseded_clauses: Where the same client holds an active pantry programme at the site named on the cafe contract, the cafe administration fee is not charged on invoiced food cost for that site, because the pantry programme already carries a delivery and handling charge for the same kitchen.
